name: ${mod_name}
description: Turns image, GIF and video links shared in chat into rich in-game media: hover any [picture] or [gif] to see an instant preview, pin images as movable, resizable windows, and click a video link to play it inside Minecraft with sound. Supports direct image and video files, animated Tenor GIFs, HLS/DASH streams and YouTube (via yt-dlp), with full playback controls, a queue and background playback.
